FOR testing

```{r, echo = TRUE, results = "hide", warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, error = FALSE}
screening.test <- stochprofIC.pipeline(d = breast.cancer,
                expr = "TPM",
                gene = "gene", 
                type = "type",
                covariates = "biopsy",
                re = NA,   # not implemented yet
                log.1st = FALSE, 
                log.2nd = TRUE,
                add1.1st = FALSE, 
                add1.2nd = TRUE,
                trim.1st = 3, 
                trim.2nd = NA,
                zeros.1st = TRUE, zeros.2nd = FALSE,
                zero.value.1st = NA, zero.value.2nd = 0,
                re.placement = "both",
                return="screening")
```

```{r}
screening.test
```

This is correctly returning the first part of the pipeline (screening).

It returns the genes that passes Sidak correction, as well as the sigma type estimates from gamlss.

```{r, echo = TRUE, results = "hide", warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, error = FALSE}
testing.test <- stochprofIC.pipeline(d = breast.cancer,
                                       expr = "TPM",
                                       gene = "gene", 
                                       type = "type",
                                       covariates = "biopsy",
                                       re = NA,   # not implemented yet
                                       log.1st = FALSE, 
                                       log.2nd = TRUE,
                                       add1.1st = FALSE, 
                                       add1.2nd = TRUE,
                                       trim.1st = 3, 
                                       trim.2nd = NA,
                                       zeros.1st = TRUE, zeros.2nd = FALSE,
                                       zero.value.1st = NA, zero.value.2nd = 0,
                                       re.placement = "both",
                                       return="testing")
```

```{r}
testing.test
```

This is correctly returning the second part of the pipeline (testing).

It returns the genes that passes False Discovery Rate (FDR), as well as the sigma type estimates from gamlss.

```{r, echo = TRUE, results = "hide", warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, error = FALSE}
correcting.inferring.test <- stochprofIC.pipeline(d = breast.cancer,
                                       expr = "TPM",
                                       gene = "gene", 
                                       type = "type",
                                       covariates = "biopsy",
                                       re = NA,   # not implemented yet
                                       log.1st = FALSE, 
                                       log.2nd = TRUE,
                                       add1.1st = FALSE, 
                                       add1.2nd = TRUE,
                                       trim.1st = 3, 
                                       trim.2nd = NA,
                                       zeros.1st = TRUE, zeros.2nd = FALSE,
                                       zero.value.1st = NA, zero.value.2nd = 0,
                                       re.placement = "both",
                                       return="correcting&inferring")
```

```{r}
correcting.inferring.test
```

This is correctly returning the last part of the pipeline (correcting&inferring).

It returns a list with three objects:
- All the gamlss estimates from the final selected genes ('Coefficients')
- The corrected output data together with the non-corrected (TPM), for comparison ('Corrected output'). This output can be used for forthcoming analyses (e.g. stochprofML).
- A list of genes with errors, meaning that no gamlss model has been computed due to unknown issues.

```{r}
correcting.inferring.test$`Corrected output`
correcting.inferring.test$`Coefficients`
```

If we want to save the full output of the stochprofIC.pipeline:

```{r, echo = TRUE, results = "hide", warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, error = FALSE}
full.output <- stochprofIC.pipeline(d = breast.cancer,
                                    expr = "TPM",
                                    type = "type",
                                    covariates = "biopsy",
                                    gene = "gene")
```

```{r}
full.output$Coefficients
full.output$Corrected
full.output$`Genes with error`
```
